name: Zovo Invoice
description: Create real PDF invoices from your AI chat: clients, sequential numbering, VAT, discounts and overdue reports. Tool calls need a free token minted in a browser at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect (no account, no card, 600 calls/hour free); unauthenticated clients still get initialize and tools/list.
author: theluckystrike
